name: MouseGestures Official Plugins
description: First-party action and detection plugins for MouseGestures.

plugins.name: Finder Helpers
plugins.author: MouseGestures
plugins.description: Finder and desktop helpers: copy the path of the selected items, open Terminal at the current folder, open a new Finder window, show or hide hidden files, toggle desktop icons, and eject all disks.

plugins.name: Pointer Gestures
plugins.author: MouseGestures
plugins.description: Triggers from pointer movement alone: shake left-right or up-down, draw a circle clockwise or counter-clockwise, or rest the pointer in a screen corner. Optionally require a modifier key so ordinary mouse movement never triggers.

plugins.name: Web Tools
plugins.author: MouseGestures
plugins.description: Search the selected text or clipboard on the web, look a word up in the Dictionary, open a selected link, and copy the front browser tab's URL or Markdown link.

plugins.name: Scheduler
plugins.author: MouseGestures
plugins.description: Run gesture actions on a schedule instead of a gesture: at a time of day, on certain weekdays, every N minutes, at sunrise or sunset, monthly, or once. Write your own schedules in the plugin's settings, then pick them as a Plugin trigger.

plugins.name: Screen Tools
plugins.author: MouseGestures
plugins.description: Pick a colour from anywhere on screen and copy it (hex, RGB or HSL), or flash a ring around the pointer to find it on a big or multi-monitor desktop.

plugins.name: System Events
plugins.author: MouseGestures
plugins.description: Passive triggers for things that happen to your Mac: sleep and wake, lock and unlock, power plugged or unplugged, low battery, disks connected or removed, internet lost or restored, Dark/Light Mode switches, going idle or coming back, and a chosen app launching or quitting.

plugins.name: System Toggles
plugins.author: MouseGestures
plugins.description: One-gesture system switches the built-in actions lack: Dock auto-hide, Stage Manager, keep awake, Wi-Fi, microphone mute and the screen saver.

plugins.name: Text
plugins.author: MouseGestures
plugins.description: Format, clean up and convert text with one gesture: change case, clean whitespace, sort and edit lines, wrap, Markdown, encode/decode, JSON, calculate, count words, and insert dates, UUIDs or your own snippets. Works on the selection or the clipboard.

plugins.name: Timers & Alarms
plugins.author: MouseGestures
plugins.description: Countdown timers, Pomodoro cycles, alarms (once, daily or weekdays), a stopwatch and a spoken clock — each can run another gesture action when it goes off. Timers and alarms survive restarts.
